passage: As a work of scholarship, Perspectives on Afro-Caribbean Spiritual Traditions (2022) is notable for its ______. Featuring contributions from Kwame Osei, Emily Clarke, and others, it explores contemporary practices while also providing context dating all the way back to the seventeenth century on African diaspora communities and their experiences with faith and ritual.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's description of what makes this scholarly work notable. In this context, 'scope' means breadth or range. The text emphasizes the work's comprehensive coverage through multiple contributors (Kwame Osei, Emily Clarke, and others), its examination of both contemporary and historical dimensions, and its temporal span of over three centuries, dating 'all the way back to the seventeenth century.' These details all demonstrate the work's extensive scope.
